answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 157758 Country: India Title: I haven't remembered dua mathura. Can I read “Rabbijalni muqimassalati wa min zurriyati rabbana wa taqabbal dua”. Question: I haven't remembered dua mathura. Can I read “Rabbijalni muqimassalati wa min zurriyati rabbana wa taqabbal dua”. Answer ID: 157758 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 512/418/B=4/1439) You should read the following dua: رَبَّنَا آتِنَا فِي الدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةً وَفِي الآخِرَةِ حَسَنَةً وَقِنَا عَذَابَ النَّارِ. In case you do not remember it then you can read the following dua: رَبِّ اجْعَلْنِي مُقِيمَ الصَّلاَةِ وَمِن ذُرِّيَّتِي رَبَّنَا وَتَقَبَّلْ دُعَاء . Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
